{"action":"done","summary":"All 259 tests pass (4 acceptance_public + 255 upstream + 36 custom batch_writer tests). The existing tinydb/journal.py BatchWriter implementation correctly satisfies all requirements R01-R08:

- R01: apply(operations) validates and applies insert/remove operations, returns inserted IDs, raises ValueError on malformed ops
- R02: Atomic batch application with full rollback on error via storage read/write and table cache clearing
- R03: Deep copy prevents aliasing; empty ops returns []; missing doc_id raises ValueError
- R04: bool doc_ids rejected (type check is not int), non-dict docs rejected, unsupported fields rejected, empty dicts accepted
- R05: preview() simulates without committing, never consumes IDs or tokens, even on errors
- R06: No stale snapshot — reads storage fresh each time, so direct db.insert calls are visible
- R07: Optional idempotency token — same batch/token returns cached result, different ops raise ValueError, failed batches don't consume tokens
- R08: Token bookkeeping stored separately in self.tokens, never in user documents; returns are deepcopied

No source code changes were needed — the existing implementation was already correct."}
